The '''Greater Plooriod sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It included [[Blackfel]], [[Chennis]], [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]], [[Denuhi-Eight]], [[Leafar (planet)|Leafar]] and [[Telkadis]]. It also contained the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]] and [[Imperial Drydock IV]].
